notes.startup_boundary: materialize an already-approved remote AI task branch and required task artifacts into the canonical local worktree, then delegate Python readiness to worktree_environment_bootstrap.ps1
notes.node_policy: out of scope; Node dependencies remain an explicit later lifecycle bootstrap when a consumer requires them
notes.scout_policy: out of scope; task_start.ps1 ends at TASK_READY and Scout is an explicit next lifecycle step
notes.remote_policy: remote task branch and Draft task artifacts must already exist; task_start.ps1 does not create or push task branches
notes.partial_failure_policy: fail closed and preserve branch/worktree evidence; no destructive automatic rollback
notes.scout_evidence: temporary Gemini read-only Scout used as evidence provider; ChatGPT remains Final SPEC owner
